name: Tōkamachi (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Tōkamachi city emblem in green, orange and light blue: a green stylised figure with an orange disc above light blue wavy lines.
history: Municipal flag of Tōkamachi, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2005.
